NOTICE: A copy of the following public hearing staff reports and Initial Studies, if applicable, for the Planning Commission projects will be available for review during regular working hours of 7:00 a.m. to 5:30 p.m., Monday - Thursday at the Planning Division and during regular hours of the Azusa City Library. Any questions regarding any agenda item may be answered by the Planning Division at (626) 812-5017. The Planning Commission Meetings are held at 7:00 p.m. in the Azusa Civic Auditorium at 213 East Foothill Boulevard, Azusa, California.

Use Permit UP 2011-01 & Design Review DR-2011-13 Location: 551 N. Rockvale Avenue
APN: 8612-002-903
Applicant: Verizon Wireless
A request for approval of a Use Permit and Design Review to allow Verizon Wireless to construct a 50' foot stealth telecommunication facility. The proposed telecommunication tower is designed to resemble a pine tree in order to adequately screen the facility, resembling a pine tree. The proposed telecommunication facility would be situated within an open field on the Charles Lee Elementary School campus, in the institutional (INS) zone.
